content: CS and HS are a candidate and human summary. $P(w)$ is the probability of word $w$ using a language model. $\alpha , \beta $ are weighting parameters. In this work we use $\alpha =\beta =1$ for all experiments. $R_{i}(CS,HS)$ is ROUGE-i score between CS and HS for i=1, 2, and $l$.
